title: Limited Enchanted Golden Apples
description: This is a Datapack that limits Enchanted Golden Apples to only 5 per player.
body:
Limited Enchanted Golden Apples is a lightweight datapack that restricts how many Enchanted Golden Apples each player can carry at once. This is good for servers that don't want players to be to overpowered.

# Features
Limits players to 5 Enchanted Golden Apples by default.
This will happen when Enchanted Golden Apples are
* Naturally generated
* Or any other method of obtaining them

# Configuration

The default limit is **5** but you can easily change it in the config file to fit your needs.
